messages:
claudia: Heads-up — dashboard telemetry shows a sharp spike in fncall schema errors for product-search-adapter.
raj: saw that. looks like validator JSONPath is matching tool responses + top-level items -> shows as rejects but invoke still proceeds downstream.
kevin: is this the 'parse shadowing' case we discussed last month? can you paste a minimal payload and traces?
claudia: Trace: https://traces/redwood/trace/abc123 — minimal payload snip:
```json
{ "user_input": "search for chairs", "tool_response": { "items": [] }, "items": [] }
```
kevin: ah ok — the validator rule `$.items[*]` is matching both arrays when empty and the hand-rolled matcher prefers the first hit.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout 2026-03-22T10:00 -> canary-3 applied to validator-service
tori: This will misattribute quota/billing to strict-validate routes, right? we'll see reject_count increment but requests still billed as invokes.
raj: yes — quota shows reject_count++ on strict routes but actual invoke metrics show success -> double counting for chargeback.
lucas: Console currently surfaces validation_code=invalid_shape only. We need parsing_context or matched_jsonpath in telemetry to filter these shadow matches.
kevin: proposal: tighten validator namespace to expect `fncall.tool` explicit key for tool payloads. short-term: treat empty arrays as non-match for ambiguous JSONPath.
claudia: short-term hotfix sounds good. we'll also mute the validation-alert for that rule for 1 hour during rollout.
raj: I can cut the hotfix and open PR now. I'll add a telemetry flag `parse_shadowing=true` sampled at 20% to backfill ambiguous cases.
tori: :thumbsup: who will own console filter and runbook note?
lucas: I'll add a console filter called `parse_shadowing` and a column showing `matched_jsonpath_snippet` for triage.
kevin: I'll update the runbook and add a billing delta monitor; add `route_tag=strict-validate` when generating the metric so chargeback teams can slice.
ops-bot: incident-bot: creating incident INC-2026-031 -> "parse-shadowing fncall" assigned to @raj
lucas: small UX ask: when validation shows invalid_shape, show a 50-char payload snippet and the matched JSONPath so engineers can triage faster.
claudia: filing frontend ticket: https://issues/redwood/1234 and adding note to the rollout checklist. thx all.
